how_to_reproduce: Run the 'Demo Trigger' manual trigger. Performs live web search through Firecrawl plus two model calls through the Model Router.
note: Live web results change over time, so the exact sources and figures will differ on a re-run. What is asserted here is structural: sources were retrieved and deduplicated, the report cited only real markers, and every claim was checked against the retrieved evidence.

runs.defect_found: The entailment judge received 20 claims and its response did not parse, so groundedness was silently skipped while the report was still reported as verified. Two fixes followed: verified is now false whenever grounding was applicable but did not happen, and the judge-response parser accepts more envelope shapes.

verification.note: The judge response was truncated and repaired. Two of the NOT_STATED verdicts were markdown headings rather than factual claims, which led to the claim splitter being tightened afterwards so document furniture is no longer sent to the judge.

assertion: Across both runs the report never cited a marker or a URL that was not present in the retrieved evidence. That is checked deterministically by the verification layer, not by inspection.
not_yet_measured: Retrieval quality against a labelled ground-truth set. The runs above prove the pipeline executes and that citations are real, not that the answers are the best possible ones.
